items.title: Expert view: Valuations still a concern, expect moderate returns for the rest of 2026, says Kotak Life's head of equity
items.summary: In a revealing interview, Hemant Kanawala from Kotak Life Insurance provides insight into the Indian stock market’s complex landscape. He highlights selective value amidst high valuations, stressing a disciplined investment approach and underlying economic strengths.

items.title: FDA buckles under HC heat, revives Mumbai Cricket Association's suspended eateries after fresh inspection
items.summary: The Bombay High Court warned food officials, leading to a license suspension withdrawal. Restaurants on Mumbai Cricket Association premises will now reopen their services. A recent inspection confirmed 88 percent compliance with food safety rules. The court criticized the FDA for a pedantic rather than pragmatic view. Officials faced potential contempt action for disobeying court orders.

items.title: Ather launches Konarc electric scooter at ₹99,999 with 200 km range, 10-year battery warranty
items.summary: The new Konarc electric scooter by Ather Energy is now on the market, starting at ₹99,999. This model features the innovative EL platform and comes in six distinct variants. Prioritizing ride comfort and road stability, the Konarc introduces an in-house developed Advanced Electronic Braking System for heightened safety. Additionally, it offers a remarkable 10-year battery warranty along with increased service intervals for added convenience.

items.title: Revised CBG pricing to support producers, consumer impact to remain negligible: Petroleum Ministry
items.summary: New Delhi's petroleum ministry clarified Compressed Biogas pricing changes on Saturday. The revised framework offers producers a stable and viable price for their biogas. Government affordability support and a wider gas pool protect consumers from price hikes. This ensures the viability of biogas plants while maintaining consumer affordability. The impact on consumers is expected to remain negligible due to these measures.

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO: SEBI clears DRHP; here's all you need to know
items.summary: Jio Platforms Ltd has received approval from India’s markets regulator for its IPO, which could become the largest in India. The company plans to raise ₹35,000 crore through new shares, and global investors have shown significant interest amid the upcoming listing.

items.title: BlackRock helps pull more Bitcoin wealth deeper into Wall Street
items.summary: BlackRock and other Wall Street firms are making it easier for large Bitcoin holders to move crypto wealth into spot Bitcoin ETFs through in-kind transactions. Lower minimums, expanding market infrastructure and growing demand for simpler custody are accelerating the shift, further integrating Bitcoin holdings into mainstream financial markets.

items.title: India’s housing market sees structural shift towards premium, luxury homes: CareEdge Ratings
items.summary: India’s housing market is seeing a structural shift towards premium and luxury homes, with affordable housing losing share in new launches. CareEdge Ratings said stronger demand from affluent buyers and rising development costs are driving the shift, even as housing sales moderate in some major cities amid affordability pressures and cautious sentiment.

items.title: Rays of Belief IPO opens 1 September: GMP hints 12% listing pop; Check 10 key things to know
items.summary: Rays of Belief IPO opens for subscription on 1 September, with a grey market premium of ₹29. The IPO price band is set at ₹227-239. Funds will support expansion, including the establishment of new centres from FY27 to FY29.

items.title: Vanguard’s India Portfolio: 12 stocks surge up to 190% in CY26; 3 multibaggers, 3 new entrants
items.summary: Vanguard Funds’ Indian portfolio saw strong gains in CY26, with 11 stocks rising up to 189%. The fund also added three new companies during the June 2026 quarter.

items.title: Steel demand outruns capacity as prices stage comeback from monsoon slump: Kotak
items.summary: Domestic steel demand is projected to remain strong, exceeding capacity additions through FY2029. Robust consumption trends are supported by healthy industrial and infrastructure activity across India. Long steel prices have recovered significantly and are expected to rise further with favorable seasonality. Flat steel prices are currently at a discount to import parity, with regional prices potentially increasing.

items.title: CNG prices will come down after US-Iran situation normalises: BJP spokesperson Shahnawaz Hussain
items.summary: In Delhi, the cost of CNG has gone up by Rs 3.89 per kg, reflecting a response to rising import costs and geopolitical uncertainties on a global scale. Significant unrest in West Asia has disrupted vital shipping lanes for natural gas. Nonetheless, Indraprastha Gas Limited continues to protect consumers from harsh market fluctuations while ensuring a reliable supply of CNG.

items.title: Launch of 6,000 luxury hotel rooms likely in Delhi by 2030
items.summary: Delhi NCR anticipates significant hotel room additions by 2030. New luxury hotels from Taj, Marriott, and Hyatt are planned. Approximately 4,000 to 5,000 rooms are expected to open by 2029. High land costs and development constraints continue to limit new supply. The market remains supply constrained with strong performance indicators.

items.title: Currency hedging to add 6-8% to green project financing costs: CII-IIMA report
items.summary: Currency hedging could increase India’s green project financing costs by 6–8% annually, potentially deterring global institutional investors, according to a CII-IIM Ahmedabad taskforce. The currency mismatch between rupee revenues and foreign-currency funding raises risks for clean-energy projects. The taskforce has proposed an FX risk facility and Green Finance Institution to reduce financing costs and attract private capital.

items.title: Will Dalal Street see record Rs 70,000 crore IPOs in September? Jio and NSE buzz raises stakes
items.summary: India’s IPO market could see a record fundraising month in September, with companies potentially raising up to Rs 70,000 crore if Jio Platforms or NSE launches its public issue. More than 25 IPOs are expected, as strong domestic liquidity, improved listing performance, and pent-up supply drive the primary market revival.

items.title: Apparel exporters urge commerce minister Piyush Goyal to regulate cotton yarn exports
items.summary: Apparel exporters requested government intervention to regulate cotton yarn exports. Rising yarn prices are significantly hurting the industry's global competitiveness. Limited stock and increased demand from countries like Bangladesh and Vietnam contribute. Higher manufacturing costs affect opportunities in new free trade agreement markets. Value addition through finished garments offers greater economic benefits than raw materials.

items.title: Buy or sell stocks: Sumeet Bagadia recommends three shares to buy on Monday — 31 August 2026
items.summary: Buy or sell: Sumeet Bagadia recommends three stocks to buy on Monday — TCS, Axis Bank, and Bajaj Auto

items.title: F&O Talk: Traders should maintain caution amid CAS volatility, says Sudeep Shah; picks 6 stocks for next week
items.summary: The Indian stock market ended higher on Friday, but heightened volatility and sharp index divergences amid the Closing Auction Session (CAS) have kept traders cautious. Technical analyst Sudeep Shah expects Nifty and Sensex to remain range-bound, while highlighting key support and resistance levels and identifying six stocks that could outperform in the coming week.

items.title: Argentina to ease pharma barriers as India trade tops $6.5 bn
items.summary: Argentina committed to reducing barriers for Indian pharmaceutical entry. This move will offer greater opportunities for Indian companies and improve healthcare access. Discussions occurred during Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal's visit to Buenos Aires this week. Bilateral trade between India and Argentina exceeded six point five billion dollars in 2025. Emerging cooperation areas include aviation, space technology, and digital services.

items.title: IPO fever grips D-Street: 3 issues to open for subscription; 8 new listings lined up for next week
items.summary: India’s primary market is set for a busy week, with three mainboard IPOs opening to raise a combined Rs 1,264.72 crore. Meanwhile, eight companies are scheduled to list, including five that have completed their IPOs and three whose ongoing issues will close before their shares make their D-Street debut.

items.title: UPI’s market share expands more at debit, credit cards’ expense
items.summary: UPI now dominates India's digital merchant payments, capturing a significant market share. Credit and debit cards are steadily losing their previous positions in this sector. The digital payments market continues to expand, with UPI capturing much of this growth. Proposed changes may introduce nominal charges on select higher-value UPI merchant transactions. This shift focuses on the sustainability of the UPI payment ecosystem.

items.title: Gold price surge brings huge gains to producers in Q1’26, WGC says
items.summary: Global average gold producer All-In Sustaining Costs (AISC) rise by 5% quarter-on-quarter and 16% year-on-year to $1,785 per ounce during the first quarter of 2026

items.title: RBI rate hike risk rises: Bandhan AMC’s Suyash Choudhary dials back duration in bond portfolios
items.summary: Bandhan AMC has reduced duration across several bond funds as RBI rate hike risks rise following the latest MPC minutes. CIO Suyash Choudhary said markets are increasingly debating the timing and magnitude of potential hikes, while fading FCNR flows and changing policy expectations could drive a flatter bond yield curve.

items.title: Surging gold prices drive record margins despite mining costs rising 16% in Q1'26: World Gold Council
items.summary: Gold producers achieved record margins and cash flows in early 2026. Rising royalty payments significantly increased mining costs during this period. Despite higher expenses, gold prices surged to historic highs. Miners maintained capital discipline, returning substantial funds to shareholders. Supply chain disruptions are expected to further impact costs in the next quarter.

items.title: Indian bank stocks show widest exchange price gap in decades
items.summary: Indian bank stocks saw unusually wide price gaps between the NSE and BSE during Thursday’s closing auction, with IndusInd Bank recording its widest exchange price difference in more than two decades. The divergence has intensified scrutiny of the new auction system amid thin liquidity, monthly expiry pressures and concerns over market manipulation.

items.title: 'Key to long-term growth': Temasek backs Singapore Airlines’ Air India bet amid investor scrutiny
items.summary: Singapore's Temasek supports Singapore Airlines' Air India investment for future growth. This strategic move aims to deepen the carrier's presence in India's large aviation market. Singapore Airlines seeks to establish a second hub outside its home country. Temasek acknowledges the complex, multi-year integration challenges ahead. The investor believes these initiatives are vital for sustained long-term growth.

items.title: Expert view: FPIs turn positive on India | OmniScience Capital CEO sees non-AI diversification boosting inflows
items.summary: Vikas Gupta, CEO of OmniScience Capital, discusses the recent positive shift in Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) towards Indian equities. With a focus on non-AI diversification and strong growth sectors, Gupta outlines a hopeful outlook for the Indian market amid global inflation pressures.

items.title: India forex reserves hit record high on RBI steps to attract US dollars
items.summary: The boost to India's forex reserves has given RBI more firepower to support the rupee, which remains one of Asia’s worst-performing currencies.

items.title: Wholesale milk prices in Mumbai to rise ₹9 per litre to cross ₹100 from Sept 1
items.summary: Starting on September 1, Mumbai's milk wholesale prices are set to surge by ₹9 per litre, a change driven by increased operating expenditures for dairy farmers. This new pricing structure will be maintained for six months, necessitating local vendors and dairies to revise their retail costs. As a result, businesses reliant on milk will also incur higher input expenses.

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 13 smallcap stocks that gain for 5 days in a row, surge up to 45%
items.summary: Thirteen BSE SmallCap stocks advanced for five straight trading sessions through August 28, delivering cumulative gains of up to 45% despite a broader market decline during the period.

items.title: Max Estates to acquire 84.71-acre land in West Delhi for Rs 420 crore
items.summary: Max Estates will acquire 84.71 acres in West Delhi through a non-cash share swap, issuing up to 70 lakh equity shares worth ₹420.2 crore to the landowners. The deal gives Max Estates its first Delhi foothold and is expected to unlock ₹10,000–12,000 crore in gross development value. It expands the company’s residential presence across Delhi, Noida and Gurugram.

items.title: Bajaj Finance, L&T Finance poised to benefit as NBFC earnings recovery broadens: Siddhartha Khemka
items.summary: India’s NBFC sector is showing signs of a broad-based cyclical recovery, with FY27 first-quarter results pointing to stronger loan growth, improving asset quality, lower credit costs and emerging operating leverage. Earnings estimates are also being upgraded, raising expectations of sustained profitability and a potential valuation re-rating across leading lenders.

items.title: Budget 2027: Finance Ministry sets October 12 for pre-Budget meetings, seeks spending and revenue plans
items.summary: As the 2027-28 Union Budget approaches, central ministries are tasked with crafting practical fiscal estimates. The Finance Ministry emphasizes the importance of controlling expenditures and increasing revenue. Pre-Budget meetings, starting in October 2026, will focus on refining these estimates. Ministries are advised to prioritize funding for ongoing projects before introducing new schemes, while also working to boost non-tax revenue and evaluate current programs.

items.title: BSE, Hindustan Zinc among 5 stocks with revenue growth of up to 64% in 1 year. Check details
items.summary: B SE, Muthoot Finance and Hindustan Zinc led five stocks with the highest revenue growth over the past year, alongside strong profit growth and five-star Value Research ratings.

items.title: India wants global factories, but its own quality checks may be putting investors off: GTRI
items.summary: Concerns have surfaced among Japanese enterprises regarding India's compulsory BIS certification rules. A newly released study proposes a significant revamp of the QCO framework. The existing regulations are leading to considerable delays and inflated compliance costs for manufacturers, adversely impacting smaller businesses in India and disrupting supply chains. Experts recommend implementing a risk-based regulatory framework to modernize and simplify quality control processes.

items.title: Crude oil prices end winning run with first weekly fall in nearly a month. Can liquid gold slide further?
items.summary: Crude oil prices posted their first weekly decline in three weeks as improving flows through the Strait of Hormuz eased supply concerns. Brent fell over 5% for the week, while WTI declined more than 4%. However, prolonged shipping disruptions could push prices higher, with JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs flagging upside risks.

items.title: Sam Altman vs Elon Musk: Why OpenAI ended partnership with Cursor after SpaceX acquisition – Explained
items.summary: OpenAI will end its partnership with Cursor due to trust issues following SpaceX's acquisition. This decision will affect developers relying on OpenAI models, with access to be withdrawn by 12 November 2026.

items.title: Investors heartened by Warsh inflation talk, still uncertain about Fed action
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh made it clear that inflation control is a top priority. He suggested that to combat escalating price pressures, interest rate hikes may soon be necessary. This announcement sent the markets into a hawkish frenzy, heightening expectations for a rate increase come September. Investors remain cautious, eagerly anticipating key economic data on jobs and inflation for guidance on potential Fed actions.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Jobs report, Broadcom results pose next hurdles for stock market rally
items.summary: In the coming week, the U.S. jobs data will be a focal point for investors, potentially impacting the Federal Reserve's interest rate strategies. Broadcom's quarterly results are anticipated right after Nvidia's stellar performance. The sustained rise in corporate profits is driving a bullish phase in U.S. equities, with optimism fueled by robust activities in the manufacturing and services sectors.

items.title: Gold drops 3% as Fed's Warsh comments lift rate hike bets
items.summary: On Friday, gold prices plummeted by more than three percent due to comments from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh regarding inflation. As a result, traders heightened their expectations for a possible interest rate increase in September. Consequently, gold futures closed lower, retreating from their recent peaks, while a stronger dollar made gold less accessible to foreign investors.

items.title: Oil settles lower on clues about Fed policy, rumors of Hormuz deal
items.summary: On Friday, oil prices dipped, driven by signals from the Federal Reserve and circulating rumors regarding the Strait of Hormuz. Market traders assessed the possibility of rate hikes by the U.S. Federal Reserve aimed at battling inflation. Additionally, talks of a potential agreement to reopen the Strait influenced the market dynamics, which were affected by inconsistent oil flows, as U.S. officials addressed Venezuelan crude reserves.

items.title: Global Markets | European shares rise as French stocks rebound; markets digest Warsh speech
items.summary: European stock markets experienced a slight uptick this week, buoyed by a notable recovery in French equities. Investors keenly scrutinized remarks from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh for insights into future monetary policies. With a downward revision in French GDP growth, concerns loom over the economy, prompting traders to adjust expectations for European Central Bank interest rate shifts. Positive earnings reports from various companies also contributed to stock value increases.

items.title: Tech leads D-Street bound, FPI play in focus
items.summary: On Friday, Indian equities bounced back, driven predominantly by a surge in technology stocks. Investors showed renewed interest in undervalued IT shares, aided by a decline in crude oil prices. After a prolonged period of selling, foreign investors reversed their trend, becoming net buyers in July and August. Broader market indices also benefited from this trend, as mid and small-cap stocks appreciated.

items.summary: This year, numerous firms across various sectors are grappling with a lack of returns, a stark contrast to the previous years' performances. items.summary: Passenger vehicle demand shows constructive growth, likely exceeding nine to ten percent year-on-year. Two-wheeler retail growth is estimated between eighteen and twenty percent during August. Commercial vehicles also posted steady trends with double-digit retail growth. Demand in southern markets led passenger vehicle sales due to early Onam. Improved supply chains and steady inquiry levels support broad-based retail momentum.

items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority aims to hold drug manufacturers solely accountable for the excessive pricing of essential medications. Manufacturers are likely to challenge the proposal, alleging it is uncompromising and unjust. Previously, substantial penalties have been levied against drugmakers for such transgressions.

items.summary: India has doubled electromagnetic field limits for mobile networks to global standards. This change allows telecom operators to cover larger areas with fewer towers. It aims to ensure quality service amid rising 5G traffic.
